definitions.explanation: A chaotic fight involving multiple people, with no rules or order. Used for physical altercations in real life, sports, and also in gaming contexts.

examples.japanese: {試合後|しあいご}に{乱闘|らんとう}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A brawl broke out after the game.

examples.japanese: {酔|よ}った{客|きゃく}たちが{乱闘|らんとう}{騒|さわ}ぎを{起|お}こした。
{警察|けいさつ}が{駆|か}けつけたときには、{乱闘|らんとう}はすでに{収|おさ}まっていた。
examples.english: By the time the police arrived, the brawl had already subsided.

notes:
A disorderly, chaotic fight involving multiple people. Stronger and more violent than {喧嘩|けんか} (quarrel/fight), and implies a lack of order or rules.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乱闘|らんとう}{騒|さわ}ぎ: brawl; ruckus involving fighting
- {乱闘|らんとう}が{起|お}きる: a brawl breaks out
- {乱闘|らんとう}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in a brawl
- {乱闘|らんとう}{劇|げき}: dramatic brawl; wild fight scene

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {喧嘩|けんか}: fight, quarrel — can be verbal or physical, usually between two people
- {殴|なぐ}り{合|あ}い: fistfight — specifically punching each other
- {格闘|かくとう}: combat, grappling — more organized, can be martial arts

FORMS:
{乱|らん} (disorder, chaos) + {闘|とう} (fight, battle) — a disorderly fight.
